name: blender_render
description: Render in a separate background Blender (the open one stays usable), to the EXACT output you name: an image (still.png), frames with a # run (shots/shot_####.png gives shot_0001.png...) or an H.264 video (final.mp4). The scene's final output (sequencer when used; source scene or sequencer forces it), with the file's settings unless overridden for this render only: resolution [w, h], samples, engine. It reads the file as saved; with unsaved changes give unsaved save or copy. Returns a task: call again with task (and wait_s) for progress, or cancel. Relative paths are next to the .blend.

task.description: A task from an earlier call: its progress.

wait_s.description: With task: wait up to this long for it to finish (0 to 3600).
